            while st:

                nb=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1)]

            b=min(rs); l=min(cs)
            g=[[1 if (b+x,l+y) in set(comp) else 0 for y in range(max(cs)-l+1)] for x in range(max(rs)-b+1)]

            sH=all(g[x][y]==g[h-1-x][y] for x in range(h) for y in range(w))
